mapper.select: SELECT cm.comment_id as commentId, cm.content, cm.parent_comment_id as parentCommentId, cm.like_count as likeCount, cm.report_count as reportCount, cm.user_id as userId, u.nickname as userNickname, cm.post_id as postId, cm.created_at as createdAt, cm.updated_at as updatedAt FROM COMMENT cm JOIN USER u ON cm.user_id = u.user_id WHERE cm.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY cm.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMENT ( content, user_id, post_id, parent_comment_id ) VALUES ( #{dto.content}, #{userId}, #{postId}, #{dto.parentCommentId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE COMMENT SET content = #{dto.content}, parent_comment_id = #{dto.parentCommentId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND user_id = #{userId}
